evals.prompt: Write me a LinkedIn post about why most cold outreach fails. Make it punchy with some stats.
evals.expected_output: Should check for outbound-context.md and the user's past posts. Must not invent statistics or anecdotes; should ask for a real number or story, or write without stats. The hook should rest on a concrete real anchor. No em dashes, no 'X, not Y' reveals, no self-answered questions.
assertions: Checks for outbound-context.md or past posts
Asks for real material or uses only what was given
No em dashes in the draft
No 'it's not X, it's Y' construction

evals.prompt: no se que postear en linkedin. vendo software de rutas para empresas de logística
evals.expected_output: Should answer in Spanish. Should propose one subject (where logistics companies' pain meets route software) and offer topic ideas across the four pillars (tactical, aspirational, personal, insight) instead of asking the user to pick a topic cold. Should suggest about one post a week.
assertions: Proposes one subject linking ICP pain and the product
Offers ideas across all four pillars
Does not ask the user to choose a topic from scratch

evals.prompt: My last post got 40,000 impressions but zero leads. Was it a success?
evals.expected_output: Should say impressions are not the measure; leads, saves, sends, profile visits and ICP engagement are. Should ask who engaged (ICP or not) and suggest working the people who reacted.
assertions: Says impressions alone do not mean success
Names leads, saves or ICP engagement as the measures
Suggests checking whether the ICP engaged
Suggests reaching out to people who reacted
